name: Self Employment Scheme
benefit: Under this scheme, a subsidy of 33% of the unit cost or a maximum of Rs. 1.00 Lakh will be given to persons belonging to religious minority communities
eligibility_rules: Applicants must belong to the State Religious Minority Community. The applicant must be a permanent resident of the State. The age limit of the applicant is between 18 to 55 years. Family annual income from all sources should not be more than Rs.81,000/- in a rural areas and Rs. 1,03,000 in urban areas. No member of the applicant's family shall be an employee of the State/Central/ Government PSU.Applicants should not have availed of a loan in KMDC earlier.
No member of the applicant's family should be an employee of the State/Central/ Government Public Sector Units. Applicants should not have availed of a loan in KMDC earlier.
exclusions: No member of the applicant's family should be an employee of the State/Central/ Government Public Sector Units. Applicants should not have availed of a loan in KMDC earlier.
